<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0a0a">
<title>STATAX · Analytics</title>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@4.1.3/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js"></script>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
:root{--red:#f00;--green:#00e676;--amber:#fa0;--blue:#4a4dff;--pink:#ff0080;--bg:#0a0a0a;--panel:#131313;--p2:#0d0d0d;--line:#222;--muted:#777;--txt:#e8e8e8}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);font:15px/1.5 -apple-system,'SF Pro','Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;padding:0 0 20px;max-width:100vw;overflow-x:hidden}
.section,.ind,.gauge,.fear-greed,.news-item,.pattern-item,.pf-item,.alert-item{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.topbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 16px 10px;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.logo{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700;color:var(--red)}.logo span{color:var(--txt)}
.topbar-right{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cabinet-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:10px 14px;background:#1a0000;border:1px solid var(--red);border-radius:8px;color:var(--red);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;transition:all .15s;min-height:40px}
.cabinet-link:hover{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.lang-switch{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--p2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:2px;min-height:40px;align-items:center}
.lang-btn{padding:8px 10px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.5px}
.lang-btn.on{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.plan-switch{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;padding:0 16px 12px}
.plan-btn{padding:12px 4px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;letter-spacing:.5px;cursor:pointer}
.plan-btn.on{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)}
.search-wrap{padding:0 16px 10px;position:relative;z-index:30}
.search-input{width:100%;padding:14px 44px 14px 44px;background:var(--p2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;color:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:15px;outline:none;min-height:48px}
.search-input:focus{border-color:var(--red)}
.search-icon{position:absolute;left:30px;top:24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;pointer-events:none}
.search-clear{position:absolute;right:26px;top:22px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 10px;display:none;line-height:1;min-height:40px;min-width:40px}
.search-clear.on{display:block}
.suggestions{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;top:calc(100% - 2px);background:#1a1a1a;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;z-index:100;display:none;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.suggestions.open{display:block}
.sug-item{padding:14px 16px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;color:#fff;background:transparent;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid #222;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;width:100%;text-align:left;min-height:52px;transition:background .15s}
.sug-item:hover,.sug-item:active{background:#252525}
.sug-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.sug-name{font-weight:500;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;flex:1;margin-right:8px}
.sug-type{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 7px;background:#222;border-radius:3px;flex-shrink:0}
.sug-empty,.sug-loading{padding:16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}
.quick-assets,.watchlist-row{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding-bottom:4px}
.quick-assets::-webkit-scrollbar,.watchlist-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.quick-assets{padding:0 16px 8px}.watchlist-row{padding:0 16px 12px}
.qa-btn{flex-shrink:0;padding:10px 16px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;background:var(--p2);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;cursor:pointer;min-height:40px}
.qa-btn.on{background:#1a0000;color:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}
.wl-chip{flex-shrink:0;padding:8px 12px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:#1a1200;color:var(--amber);border:1px solid #3a2800;border-radius:16px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;min-height:36px}
.wl-chip .x{font-size:16px;color:#630;padding:0 4px}
.wl-chip .wl-price{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px;color:#ccc;padding-left:6px;border-left:1px solid #3a2800}
.wl-empty{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding:4px 0}
.hero{padding:0 16px 12px}
.sym-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:4px}
.pair{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:1px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.star-btn{background:none;border:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 8px;color:#444;min-height:36px;min-width:36px}.star-btn.on{color:var(--amber)}
.change{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.change.up{color:var(--green)}.change.down{color:var(--red)}
.price{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:38px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-1px;transition:color .25s ease,text-shadow .25s ease;cursor:pointer;word-break:break-all}
.price.flash-up{color:#00e676!important;text-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(0,230,118,.65)}
.price.flash-down{color:#ff0000!important;text-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,0,0,.65)}
.price-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ws-dot{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);animation:pulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.4}}
.error-block{background:#1a0000;border:1px solid #3a0000;border-radius:10px;padding:16px;text-align:center;margin-top:10px}
.error-block .err-msg{font-size:12px;color:#f88;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.5}
.error-block .retry{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 20px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
.data-status{display:inline-block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-left:8px;vertical-align:middle;text-transform:uppercase}
.data-status.live{background:rgba(0,230,118,.15);color:var(--green)}
.data-status.ws{background:rgba(0,230,118,.25);color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,230,118,.3)}
.data-status.delayed{background:rgba(255,170,0,.15);color:var(--amber)}
.data-status.err{background:rgba(255,0,0,.15);color:var(--red)}
.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.metric{text-align:center}.metric .m-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.metric .m-val{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin-top:2px}
.signal-card{margin:0 16px 16px;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;border:1px solid}
.signal-card.buy{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#001a0a,#0a0a0a);border-color:#004422}
.signal-card.sell{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a0000,#0a0a0a);border-color:#440000}
.signal-card.hold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1200,#0a0a0a);border-color:#443300}
.sig-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sig-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
.sig-conf{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-align:right}.sig-conf strong{color:#fff;font-size:15px}
.sig-main{font-size:32px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.1}
.signal-card.buy .sig-main{color:var(--green)}.signal-card.sell .sig-main{color:var(--red)}.signal-card.hold .sig-main{color:var(--amber)}
.sig-reason{font-size:13px;color:#ccc;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:10px}
.sig-bar{height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:10px}
.sig-bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px}
.signal-card.buy .sig-bar-fill{background:var(--green)}.signal-card.sell .sig-bar-fill{background:var(--red)}.signal-card.hold .sig-bar-fill{background:var(--amber)}
.sig-tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.sig-tag{font-size:11px;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#ccc}
.sig-tag.up{background:rgba(0,230,118,.12);color:var(--green)}.sig-tag.down{background:rgba(255,0,0,.12);color:var(--red)}
.sig-plan{margin-top:12px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.sig-plan-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sig-plan-title{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700}
.sig-plan-rr{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:16px;font-weight:800}
.sig-plan-rr.good{color:var(--green)}.sig-plan-rr.ok{color:var(--amber)}.sig-plan-rr.bad{color:var(--red)}
.sig-plan-rr-lbl{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);margin-right:6px;text-transform:uppercase}
.sig-plan-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
@media(min-width:520px){.sig-plan-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.sp-item{background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;border-left:3px solid}
.sp-item.entry{border-left-color:#fff}
.sp-item.stop{border-left-color:var(--red)}
.sp-item.tp1{border-left-color:var(--green)}
.sp-item.tp2{border-left-color:#00b359}
.sp-item-l{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
.sp-item-v{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;word-break:break-all}
.sp-item.stop .sp-item-v{color:#ff6666}
.sp-item.tp1 .sp-item-v{color:#66ff66}
.sp-item.tp2 .sp-item-v{color:#4dff7a}
.sp-item-s{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.3}
.sig-plan-wait{font-size:12px;color:var(--amber);background:rgba(255,170,0,.08);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;line-height:1.5}
.sig-plan-warn{font-size:10px;color:#a80;background:rgba(255,170,0,.06);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:10px}
.chart-card{background:var(--panel);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 0 4px;margin-bottom:16px}
.chart-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0 16px 10px;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tabs button{padding:8px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;min-height:36px;white-space:nowrap}
.tabs button.on{background:#1a0000;color:var(--red)}
.chart-type-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;background:var(--p2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:3px}
.chart-type-tabs button{padding:6px 10px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;min-height:32px}
.chart-type-tabs button.on{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.chart-wrap{height:320px;padding:0;position:relative;width:100%}
@media(min-width:768px){.chart-wrap{height:400px}}
.rsi-wrap{height:80px;padding:6px 12px 0;position:relative;margin-top:4px;border-top:1px solid #1a1a1a}
.section{padding:0 16px;margin-bottom:16px;border-radius:0;border-left:none;border-right:none}
.section-title{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:1.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;justify-content:space-between}
.section-title-main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.badge{display:inline-block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
.badge.free{background:#1a1a1a;color:#999;border:1px solid #2a2a2a}
.badge.pro{background:#1a1200;color:var(--amber);border:1px solid #3a2800}
.badge.proplus{background:#1a0000;color:var(--red);border:1px solid #3a0000}
.ind-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.ind{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;position:relative;min-height:72px}
.ind .tier{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
.ind .tier.free{background:#1a1a1a;color:#999;border:1px solid #2a2a2a}
.ind .tier.pro{background:#1a1200;color:var(--amber);border:1px solid #3a2800}
.ind .tier.proplus{background:#1a0000;color:var(--red);border:1px solid #3a0000}
.ind .lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:4px}
.ind .val{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.ind .sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}.ind .sub.up{color:var(--green)}.ind .sub.down{color:var(--red)}
.levels,.patterns,.portfolio,.alerts-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.patterns,.portfolio,.alerts-list{gap:6px}
.level-row{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--panel);border-radius:6px;border-left:3px solid;gap:8px}
.level-row.r{border-left-color:var(--red)}.level-row.s{border-left-color:var(--green)}.level-row.p{border-left-color:var(--amber);background:#1a1200}
.level-row .lv-label{flex:1;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.level-row.p .lv-label{color:var(--amber);font-weight:700}
.level-row .lv-price{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.level-row .lv-dist{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:4px}
.pattern-item{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pattern-item .p-name{font-size:13px;color:#fff;font-weight:600}.pattern-item .p-desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.pattern-item .p-badge{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0}
.pattern-item .p-badge.bull{background:rgba(0,230,118,.15);color:var(--green)}
.pattern-item .p-badge.bear{background:rgba(255,0,0,.15);color:var(--red)}
.pattern-item .p-badge.neutral{background:#222;color:#999}
.gauge{border-radius:10px;padding:16px}
.g-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.g-val{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:36px;font-weight:700;margin:4px 0 10px}
.g-val.neutral{color:#fff}.g-val.up{color:var(--green)}.g-val.down{color:var(--red)}
.g-val .unit{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}
.g-bar{height:6px;background:#1a1a1a;border-radius:3px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:8px}
.g-bar::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;width:1px;height:100%;background:#333;z-index:2}
.g-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px}.g-fill.up{background:var(--green)}.g-fill.down{background:var(--red)}.g-fill.neutral{background:#888}
.g-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.components{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.comp{background:var(--p2);border-radius:6px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
.comp .c-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.comp .c-val{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-top:2px}.comp .c-weight{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)}
.ai-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a0000,#0d0505);border:1px solid #3a0000;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;position:relative}
.ai-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;left:20px;right:20px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--red),transparent);border-radius:2px}
.ai-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.ai-title{font-size:12px;color:var(--red);letter-spacing:1.5px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ai-title::before{content:'';width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--red);animation:pulse 2s infinite}
.ai-status{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);padding:3px 8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-radius:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.ai-status::before{content:'';width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.ai-summary{font-size:14px;color:#e8e8e8;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:500}
.ai-block-title{font-size:10px;color:var(--red);letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0 6px;font-weight:700}
.ai-block-text{font-size:13px;color:#bbb;line-height:1.6}
.ai-risks{margin:8px 0 0 18px}.ai-risks li{font-size:12px;color:#bbb;line-height:1.6}
.ai-levels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.ai-level{background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
.ai-level .al-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:4px}
.ai-level .al-val{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;word-break:break-all}
.ai-level .al-val.up{color:var(--green)}.ai-level .al-val.down{color:var(--red)}
.fear-greed{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px;border-radius:10px}
.fg-val{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:28px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
.fg-info{flex:1;min-width:0}.fg-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.fg-state{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}
.fg-bar{height:4px;background:#1a1a1a;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}.fg-bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:2px}
.sig-history-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}
.sig-history-table th{text-align:left;padding:8px 6px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.sig-history-table td{padding:8px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #1a1a1a;font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px}
.sig-history-table td.name{font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.sig-history-table .sig-buy{color:var(--green);font-weight:700}
.sig-history-table .sig-sell{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
.sig-history-table .sig-hold{color:var(--amber);font-weight:700}
.sig-history-table .res-pos{color:var(--green)}
.sig-history-table .res-neg{color:var(--red)}
.sig-history-table .res-neu{color:var(--muted)}
.sig-history-empty{padding:16px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.sig-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.sig-stat{background:var(--p2);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
.sig-stat .lbl{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.sig-stat .val{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-top:4px}
.sig-stat .val.pos{color:var(--green)}.sig-stat .val.neg{color:var(--red)}.sig-stat .val.neu{color:var(--muted)}
.pf-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;padding:10px;background:var(--p2);border-radius:8px}
.pf-total{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#fff}
.pf-total.pos{color:var(--green)}.pf-total.neg{color:var(--red)}

function migratePortfolio(){
  const d = Storage.load();
  let changed = false;
  Object.keys(d.portfolio).forEach(k => {
    const v = d.portfolio[k];
    if (typeof v === 'number'){ d.portfolio[k] = { qty: v, entryPrice: null }; changed = true; }
    else if (v && typeof v === 'object' && v.qty !== undefined && v.entryPrice === undefined){ v.entryPrice = null; changed = true; }
  });
  if (changed) Storage.save(d);
}

function tryConnectWs(url, symbol){

function computeSignal(snap){
  let score = 0; const reasons = [], tags = [];
  const {rsi14, sma20, sma50, macd, bullishProb, price} = snap;
  if (rsi14 != null){
    if (rsi14<30){ score+=2; reasons.push(t('signal.reason_rsi_oversold')); tags.push({t:'RSI',dir:'up'}); }
    else if (rsi14>70){ score-=2; reasons.push(t('signal.reason_rsi_overbought')); tags.push({t:'RSI',dir:'down'}); }
    else if (rsi14<45){ score+=1; tags.push({t:'RSI',dir:'up'}); }
    else if (rsi14>55){ score-=1; tags.push({t:'RSI',dir:'down'}); }
  }
  if (sma20 != null){ if (price>sma20){ score+=1; tags.push({t:'>SMA20',dir:'up'}); } else { score-=1; tags.push({t:'<SMA20',dir:'down'}); } }
  if (sma50 != null){ if (price>sma50){ score+=1; tags.push({t:'>SMA50',dir:'up'}); } else { score-=1; tags.push({t:'<SMA50',dir:'down'}); } }
  if (macd != null){ if (macd.hist>0){ score+=1; tags.push({t:'MACD',dir:'up'}); } else { score-=1; tags.push({t:'MACD',dir:'down'}); } }
  if (bullishProb != null){ if (bullishProb>=60) score+=1; else if (bullishProb<=40) score-=1; }
  const abs = Math.abs(score);
  let signal, cls, conf;
  if (score>=4){ signal=t('signal.strong_buy'); cls='buy'; conf=Math.min(95,60+abs*7); }
  else if (score>=2){ signal=t('signal.buy'); cls='buy'; conf=55+abs*6; }
  else if (score<=-4){ signal=t('signal.strong_sell'); cls='sell'; conf=Math.min(95,60+abs*7); }
  else if (score<=-2){ signal=t('signal.sell'); cls='sell'; conf=55+abs*6; }
  else { signal=t('signal.hold'); cls='hold'; conf=50+(2-abs)*5; }
  const reason = reasons.length ? reasons.join(' · ') : (cls==='buy'?t('signal.reason_buy'):cls==='sell'?t('signal.reason_sell'):t('signal.reason_hold'));
  return {signal, cls, confidence: Math.round(conf), score, tags, reason};
}

function detectLevels(candles, price, maxLevels) {
  if (!candles || candles.length < 20) return { supports: [], resistances: [] };
  const lookback = Math.min(80, candles.length);
  const cs = candles.slice(-lookback);
  const win = 3;
  const pivotsHigh = [], pivotsLow = [];
  for (let i = win; i < cs.length - win; i++) {
    let isHigh = true, isLow = true;
    for (let j = i - win; j <= i + win; j++) {
      if (j === i) continue;
      if (cs[j].h >= cs[i].h) isHigh = false;
      if (cs[j].l <= cs[i].l) isLow = false;
    }
    if (isHigh) pivotsHigh.push({ p: cs[i].h, idx: i });
    if (isLow) pivotsLow.push({ p: cs[i].l, idx: i });
  }
  function cluster(pivots, type) {
    if (!pivots.length) return [];
    const sorted = pivots.slice().sort((a, b) => a.p - b.p);
    const groups = [];
    sorted.forEach(p => {
      const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
      if (last && Math.abs(p.p - last.avg) / last.avg < 0.003) {
        last.items.push(p);
        last.avg = last.items.reduce((s, x) => s + x.p, 0) / last.items.length;
      } else groups.push({ avg: p.p, items: [p] });
    });
    return groups.map(g => {
      const touches = g.items.length;
      const strength = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, Math.round(touches / 1.5)));
      const idxMax = Math.max(...g.items.map(x => x.idx));
      const ageBars = cs.length - idxMax;
      let status = 'fresh';
      if (touches >= 3) status = 'tested';
      if (type === 'res' && price > g.avg * 1.001) status = 'flip';
      if (type === 'sup' && price < g.avg * 0.999) status = 'flip';
      if (ageBars > cs.length * 0.8) status = 'broken';
      return { price: g.avg, touches, strength, status, ageBars };
    });
  }
  const resistances = cluster(pivotsHigh, 'res').filter(l => l.price > price * 1.001).sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);
  const supports = cluster(pivotsLow, 'sup').filter(l => l.price < price * 0.999).sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price);
  return { supports: supports.slice(0, maxLevels), resistances: resistances.slice(0, maxLevels) };
}

function computeTradePlan(snap) {
  if (!snap || !snap.signal || !snap.candles) return null;
  const p = snap.price;
  const atr = snap.atr14 || p * 0.02;
  const sig = snap.signal;
  const isLong = (sig.cls === 'buy' && sig.confidence >= 55 && snap.sma50 && p > snap.sma50);
  const isShort = (sig.cls === 'sell' && sig.confidence >= 55 && snap.sma50 && p < snap.sma50);
  const levels = detectLevels(snap.candles, p, 5);
  let direction = 'wait', entry = p, stop = p, tp1 = p, tp2 = p;
  let stopReason = '', tp1Reason = '', tp2Reason = '', waitHint = '';
  if (isLong) {
    direction = 'long';
    const nearestSup = levels.supports[0], nearestRes = levels.resistances[0], secondRes = levels.resistances[1];
    if (nearestSup && (p - nearestSup.price) < atr * 3) { stop = nearestSup.price - atr * 0.5; stopReason = t('plan.under_sup'); }
    else { stop = p - atr * 2; stopReason = t('plan.atr_x2'); }
    if (nearestRes) { tp1 = nearestRes.price; tp1Reason = t('plan.res'); }
    else { tp1 = p + atr * 2; tp1Reason = t('plan.atr_x2'); }
    if (secondRes) { tp2 = secondRes.price; tp2Reason = t('plan.next_res'); }
    else { tp2 = tp1 + 1.5 * (tp1 - p); tp2Reason = t('plan.tp1_ext'); }
  } else if (isShort) {
    direction = 'short';
    const nearestRes = levels.resistances[0], nearestSup = levels.supports[0], secondSup = levels.supports[1];
    if (nearestRes && (nearestRes.price - p) < atr * 3) { stop = nearestRes.price + atr * 0.5; stopReason = t('plan.above_res'); }
    else { stop = p + atr * 2; stopReason = t('plan.atr_x2'); }
    if (nearestSup) { tp1 = nearestSup.price; tp1Reason = t('plan.sup'); }
    else { tp1 = p - atr * 2; tp1Reason = t('plan.atr_x2'); }
    if (secondSup) { tp2 = secondSup.price; tp2Reason = t('plan.next_sup'); }
    else { tp2 = tp1 - 1.5 * (p - tp1); tp2Reason = t('plan.tp1_ext'); }
  } else {
    direction = 'wait';
    if (levels.resistances[0] || levels.supports[0]) {
      waitHint = (levels.resistances[0] ? '↑ $' + levels.resistances[0].price.toFixed(2) : '—') + ' / ' + (levels.supports[0] ? '↓ $' + levels.supports[0].price.toFixed(2) : '—');
    }
  }
  const risk = Math.abs(entry - stop);
  const reward1 = Math.abs(tp1 - entry);
  const rr = risk > 0 ? reward1 / risk : 0;
  return { direction, entry, stop, tp1, tp2, rr, stopReason, tp1Reason, tp2Reason, waitHint };
}

      </div>

async function runScanner(){
  if (!has(R.SCANNER)) { renderScannerUI(); return; }
  scannerBusy = true;
  renderScannerUI();
  const results = [];
  const batchSize = 5;
  for (let i = 0; i < SCANNER_ASSETS.length; i += batchSize){
    const batch = SCANNER_ASSETS.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    await Promise.allSettled(batch.map(async (sym) => {
      try {
        const { candles } = await Market.load(sym, '1h');
        if (candles.length < 50) return;
        const closes = candles.map(c => c.c);
        const last = closes[closes.length - 1];
        const r14 = Market.rsi(closes, 14);
        const s50 = Market.sma(closes, 50);
        const a14 = Market.atr(candles, 14);
        if (r14 == null || s50 == null) return;

        let score = 0; const reasons = [];
        if (r14 < 30){ score += 3; reasons.push(t('scanner.rsi_oversold', r14.toFixed(0))); }
        else if (r14 > 70){ score -= 3; reasons.push(t('scanner.rsi_overbought', r14.toFixed(0))); }
        if (last > s50 * 1.01){ score += 2; reasons.push(t('scanner.above_sma')); }
        else if (last < s50 * 0.99){ score -= 2; reasons.push(t('scanner.below_sma')); }
        const volat = a14 ? (a14 / last) * 100 : 0;
        if (volat > 3){ score += 1; reasons.push(t('scanner.high_vol', volat.toFixed(1))); }

        if (Math.abs(score) < 2) return;
        const cls = score > 0 ? 'buy' : score < 0 ? 'sell' : 'hold';
        const sigLabel = cls === 'buy' ? t('signal.buy') : cls === 'sell' ? t('signal.sell') : t('signal.hold');
        const conf = Math.min(95, 50 + Math.abs(score) * 8);
        results.push({ sym, name: ASSETS[sym]?.name || sym, score, cls, sigLabel, conf, reasonStr: reasons.join(' · ') });
      } catch(_){}
    }));
  }
  results.sort((a,b) => Math.abs(b.score) - Math.abs(a.score));
  scannerResults = results;
  scannerBusy = false;
  renderScannerUI();
}
async function refreshScanner(){
  if (!has(R.SCANNER)) return;
  toast(t('scanner.refreshing'));
  await runScanner();
  toast(t('scanner.done'), 'ok');
}

async function buildSnapshot(){
  const {candles, asset} = await Market.load(state.assetKey, state.interval);
  const closes = candles.map(c=>c.c), last = closes[closes.length-1], prev = closes[closes.length-2]||last;
  const changePct = ((last-prev)/prev)*100;
  const s20 = Market.sma(closes,20), s50 = Market.sma(closes,50), e50 = Market.ema(closes,50);
  const r14 = Market.rsi(closes,14), a14 = Market.atr(candles,14);
  const bb = Market.boll(closes,20,2), md = Market.macd(closes), st = Market.stochastic(candles);
  let bull = null, bComp = null;
  if (r14!=null && s20!=null && a14!=null){
    const rs = Math.max(0,Math.min(100,r14)), ms = Math.max(0,Math.min(100,((last-s20)/s20)*1000+50)), as = Math.max(0,Math.min(100,100-(a14/last)*5000));
    bull = Math.round(rs*.4+ms*.35+as*.25); bComp = {rsi:Math.round(rs),ma:Math.round(ms),atr:Math.round(as)};
  }
  const s24 = candles.slice(-24);
  const m24 = {high:Math.max(...s24.map(c=>c.h)), low:Math.min(...s24.map(c=>c.l)), volume:s24.reduce((a,c)=>a+(c.v||0),0)};
  const snap = {assetKey:state.assetKey, assetName:asset.name, type:asset.type, quote:asset.quote, interval:state.interval, price:last, changePct, candles, m24};
  if (has(R.SMA)){ snap.sma20 = s20; snap.sma50 = s50; }
  if (has(R.EMA)) snap.ema50 = e50;
  if (has(R.RSI)) snap.rsi14 = r14;
  if (has(R.ATR)) snap.atr14 = a14;
  if (has(R.BULL)){ snap.bullishProb = bull; snap.bullComponents = bComp; }
  if (has(R.LEVELS)){ snap.bollinger = bb; snap.macd = md; snap.stochastic = st; snap.levels = Market.pivots(candles); }
  if (has(R.PATTERNS)) snap.patterns = Market.patterns(candles);
  if (has(R.SIGNAL)) snap.signal = computeSignal(snap);
  if (has(R.AI) && snap.signal) snap.ai = aiAnalyze(snap, snap.signal, state.horizon);
  return snap;
}

  }

  if ((cfg.level_break_up || cfg.level_break_down) && snap.candles) {
    const lv = detectLevels(snap.candles, price, 5);
    const range = price * 0.002;
    if (cfg.level_break_up && lv.resistances.length) {
      const n = lv.resistances[0];
      if (Math.abs(price - n.price) < range && n.strength >= 3 && alertCanFire('sys_breakup_' + sym, 10 * 60 * 1000)) {
        const msg = sym + ': resistance $' + n.price.toFixed(2);
        toast('⚠️ ' + msg, 'ok'); notif('STATAX · Breakout', msg);
      }

        const msg = sym + ': support $' + n.price.toFixed(2);

/* ═══ EXTRA ═══ */
const EXTRA = (() => {
  let wsDepth = null, wsTrades = null, currentSym = null;

  function fmtPrice(p) {
    if (p == null || isNaN(p)) return '—';
    let dp;
    if (p >= 100) dp = 2; else if (p >= 1) dp = 3; else if (p >= 0.01) dp = 4; else if (p >= 0.0001) dp = 6; else dp = 8;
    const parts = p.toFixed(dp).split('.');
    return parts[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',') + (parts[1] ? '.' + parts[1] : '');
  }
  function fmtQty(q) {
    if (q == null || isNaN(q)) return '—';
    if (q >= 1e6) return (q / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M';
    if (q >= 1e3) return (q / 1e3).toFixed(2) + 'K';
    if (q >= 100) return q.toFixed(1);
    if (q >= 1) return q.toFixed(2);
    if (q >= 0.01) return q.toFixed(4);

  }

  async function loadFutures(sym) {

    try {

        fetch(`https://fapi.binance.com/futures/data/globalLongShortAccountRatio?symbol=${sym}&period=1h&limit=1`).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(()=>null),

      if (prem && prem.lastFundingRate != null) {

          nextIn: prem.nextFundingTime ? Math.max(0, Math.round((prem.nextFundingTime - Date.now()) / 60000)) : null,
        };
        source = 'Binance';
      }
    } catch(_) {}

    if (!data) {
      try {
        const [tick, oiRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch(`https://api.bybit.com/v5/market/tickers?category=linear&symbol=${sym}`).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(()=>null),
          fetch(`https://api.bybit.com/v5/market/open-interest?category=linear&symbol=${sym}&intervalTime=5min`).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(()=>null),
        ]);
        if (tick && tick.result && tick.result.list && tick.result.list[0]) {
          const t2 = tick.result.list[0];
          const markPrice = parseFloat(t2.markPrice);
          const oiVal = (oiRes && oiRes.result && oiRes.result.openInterestList && oiRes.result.openInterestList[0])
            ? parseFloat(oiRes.result.openInterestList[0].openInterest)
            : parseFloat(t2.openInterest);
          data = {
            funding: parseFloat(t2.fundingRate) * 100,
            markPrice: isNaN(markPrice) ? null : markPrice,
            oiVal: isNaN(oiVal) ? null : oiVal,
            oiUsd: (!isNaN(oiVal) && !isNaN(markPrice)) ? oiVal * markPrice : null,
            lsRatio: null, longAcc: null, shortAcc: null,
            nextIn: t2.nextFundingTime ? Math.max(0, Math.round((parseInt(t2.nextFundingTime) - Date.now()) / 60000)) : null,
          };
          source = 'Bybit';
        }
      } catch(_) {}
    }

    if (!data) {
      try {
        const symOkx = sym.replace('USDT', '-USDT-SWAP');
        const [fr, oiRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch(`https://www.okx.com/api/v5/public/funding-rate?instId=${symOkx}`).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(()=>null),
          fetch(`https://www.okx.com/api/v5/public/open-interest?instId=${symOkx}`).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(()=>null),
        ]);
        if (fr && fr.data && fr.data[0]) {
          const dd = fr.data[0];
          const oiVal = oiRes && oiRes.data && oiRes.data[0] ? parseFloat(oiRes.data[0].oi) : null;
          const oiUsd = oiRes && oiRes.data && oiRes.data[0] ? parseFloat(oiRes.data[0].oiCcy) : null;
          data = {
            funding: parseFloat(dd.fundingRate) * 100,
            markPrice: null, oiVal, oiUsd,
            lsRatio: null, longAcc: null, shortAcc: null,
            nextIn: dd.nextFundingTime ? Math.max(0, Math.round((parseInt(dd.nextFundingTime) - Date.now()) / 60000)) : null,
          };
          source = 'OKX';
        }
      } catch(_) {}
    }

    if (!data) {
      box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f88;line-height:1.5;padding:8px;">${t('fut.unavailable')}</div>`;
      return;
    }

    const fmtNum = n => (n == null || isNaN(n)) ? '—' : n.toLocaleString(currentLang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'ru-RU', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    const fmtBig = n => { if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—'; if (n > 1e9) return '$' + (n / 1e9).toFixed(2) + 'B'; if (n > 1e6) return '$' + (n / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M'; if (n > 1e3) return '$' + (n / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'K'; return '$' + n.toFixed(2); };
    const lsLine = data.lsRatio != null
      ? `<div class="fut-row"><div class="fl">${t('fut.ls')}</div><div class="fv">${data.lsRatio.toFixed(2)}<span class="fv small">${data.longAcc != null ? data.longAcc.toFixed(0) + '% / ' + data.shortAcc.toFixed(0) + '%' : ''}</span></div></div>`
      : `<div class="fut-row"><div class="fl">${t('fut.ls')}</div><div class="fv" style="color:#666;">${t('fut.no_ls')}</div></div>`;

    box.innerHTML = `
      <div class="fut-row ${data.funding == null ? '' : data.funding >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg'}">
        <div><div class="fl">${t('fut.funding')}</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#666;margin-top:2px;">${data.nextIn != null ? t('fut.next_min', data.nextIn) : ''} · ${source}</div></div>
        <div class="fv ${data.funding == null ? '' : data.funding >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg'}">${data.funding == null ? '—' : (data.funding >= 0 ? '+' : '') + data.funding.toFixed(4) + '%'}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="fut-row"><div class="fl">${t('fut.oi')}</div><div class="fv">${fmtBig(data.oiUsd)}<span class="fv small">${fmtNum(data.oiVal)}</span></div></div>
      ${lsLine}
      <div class="fut-row"><div class="fl">${t('fut.mark')}</div><div class="fv">${data.markPrice != null ? '$' + fmtNum(data.markPrice) : '—'}</div></div>
    `;
  }

  async function loadGlobal() {
    const box = $('globalMetrics'); if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('common.loading')}</div>`;
    const out = [];
    try {
      if (Date.now() - lastGlobal > 300000) {
        const r = await fetch('https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/global');
        if (r.ok) { window._g = (await r.json()).data; lastGlobal = Date.now(); }
      }
      const g = window._g;
      if (g && g.market_cap_percentage) {
        const btc = g.market_cap_percentage.btc, eth = g.market_cap_percentage.eth, total = g.total_market_cap && g.total_market_cap.usd;
        out.push(`<div class="fut-row pos"><div><div class="fl">${t('global.dom')}</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#666;margin-top:2px;">ETH ${eth.toFixed(1)}%</div></div><div class="fv pos">${btc.toFixed(1)}%</div></div><div class="dom-bar"><div class="dom-bar-fill" style="width:${btc}%"></div></div>`);
        if (total) out.push(`<div class="fut-row"><div class="fl">${t('global.mcap')}</div><div class="fv">${(total / 1e12).toFixed(2)}T$</div></div>`);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (Date.now() - lastTvl > 600000) {
        const r = await fetch('https://api.llama.fi/v2/historicalChainTvl');
        if (r.ok) { const arr = await r.json(); window._tvl = arr[arr.length - 1] && arr[arr.length - 1].tvl; lastTvl = Date.now(); }
      }
      const tvl = window._tvl;
      if (tvl) out.push(`<div class="fut-row"><div class="fl">${t('global.tvl')}</div><div class="fv">${(tvl / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B$</div></div>`);
    } catch (e) {}
    box.innerHTML = out.length ? out.join('') : `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('global.unavailable')}</div>`;
  }

  function startOrderbook(sym) {
    stopOrderbook();
    const box = $('orderbookBlock'); if (!box) return;
    if (!has(R.LEVELS)) { box.innerHTML = lockedHTML(t('orderbook.title'), 'pro'); return; }
    if (!sym.endsWith('USDT')) { box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('orderbook.crypto_only')}</div>`; return; }
    box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('orderbook.loading')}</div>`;
    const isPP = Ent.has(R.AI);
    const depth = isPP ? 12 : 8;
    const lower = sym.toLowerCase();

    try {
      wsDepth = new WebSocket(`wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/${lower}@depth20@100ms`);
      wsDepth.onmessage = (e) => {
        try {
          const d = JSON.parse(e.data);
          const rawAsks = (d.asks || d.a || []).slice(0, depth).map(a => ({ p: parseFloat(a[0]), q: parseFloat(a[1]) }));
          const rawBids = (d.bids || d.b || []).slice(0, depth).map(b => ({ p: parseFloat(b[0]), q: parseFloat(b[1]) }));
          if (!rawAsks.length || !rawBids.length) return;
          const bestAsk = rawAsks[0].p, bestBid = rawBids[0].p;
          const spread = bestAsk - bestBid;
          const mid = (bestAsk + bestBid) / 2;
          const prevSnap = state.snapshot;
          const midChange = prevSnap ? mid - prevSnap.price : 0;
          const midClass = midChange > 0 ? 'change-up' : midChange < 0 ? 'change-down' : '';
          const sumAskQ = rawAsks.reduce((s, x) => s + x.q, 0), sumBidQ = rawBids.reduce((s, x) => s + x.q, 0);
          const sumAskV = rawAsks.reduce((s, x) => s + x.q * x.p, 0), sumBidV = rawBids.reduce((s, x) => s + x.q * x.p, 0);
          const totalV = sumAskV + sumBidV;
          const bidPct = totalV > 0 ? (sumBidV / totalV) * 100 : 50;
          const avgAskQ = sumAskQ / rawAsks.length, avgBidQ = sumBidQ / rawBids.length;
          const WALL = 3;
          let cumAsk = 0;
          const asksCum = rawAsks.slice().reverse().map(a => { cumAsk += a.q; return { ...a, cum: cumAsk }; });
          let cumBid = 0;
          const bidsCum = rawBids.map(b => { cumBid += b.q; return { ...b, cum: cumBid }; });
          const maxCum = Math.max(cumAsk, cumBid);
          const askRows = asksCum.map(a => {
            const wall = isPP && a.q > avgAskQ * WALL ? ' wall' : '';
            return `<div class="ob-v2-row ask${wall}"><div class="ob-v2-bar" style="width:${(a.cum / maxCum * 100).toFixed(0)}%"></div><span class="ob-v2-p">${fmtPrice(a.p)}</span><span class="ob-v2-q">${fmtQty(a.q)}</span></div>`;
          }).join('');
          const bidRows = bidsCum.map(b => {
            const wall = isPP && b.q > avgBidQ * WALL ? ' wall' : '';
            return `<div class="ob-v2-row bid${wall}"><div class="ob-v2-bar" style="width:${(b.cum / maxCum * 100).toFixed(0)}%"></div><span class="ob-v2-p">${fmtPrice(b.p)}</span><span class="ob-v2-q">${fmtQty(b.q)}</span></div>`;
          }).join('');
          const footHTML = isPP ? `<div class="ob-v2-foot"><span>${t('orderbook.pressure')}</span><div class="pressure-bar"><div class="pressure-fill" style="width:${bidPct}%"></div></div><span class="pressure-label">${bidPct.toFixed(0)}% bid</span></div><div class="ob-v2-sums"><div class="ob-v2-sum ob-v2-sum-ask"><span>${t('orderbook.asks')}</span><strong>${fmtQty(sumAskQ)}</strong></div><div class="ob-v2-sum ob-v2-sum-bid"><span>${t('orderbook.bids')}</span><strong>${fmtQty(sumBidQ)}</strong></div></div>` : '';
          box.innerHTML = `<div class="ob-v2">
            <div class="ob-v2-head"><span>${t('orderbook.title')}</span><span class="ob-v2-spread">${t('orderbook.spread')} ${fmtPrice(spread)}</span></div>
            <div class="ob-v2-side">${askRows}</div>
            <div class="ob-v2-mid ${midClass}">$${fmtPrice(mid)}</div>
            <div class="ob-v2-side">${bidRows}</div>
            ${footHTML}
          </div>`;
        } catch (_) {}
      };
      wsDepth.onerror = () => { box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('orderbook.error')}</div>`; };
    } catch (e) { box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('orderbook.error')}</div>`; }
  }
  function stopOrderbook(){ if (wsDepth) { try { wsDepth.close(); } catch (_) {} wsDepth = null; } }

  function startTrades(sym) {
    stopTrades();
    const box = $('tradesBlock'); if (!box) return;
    if (!has(R.NEWS)) { box.innerHTML = lockedHTML(t('trades.title'), 'pro'); return; }
    if (!sym.endsWith('USDT')) { box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('orderbook.crypto_only')}</div>`; return; }
    box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('orderbook.loading')}</div>`;
    tradesBuffer = [];
    const isPP = Ent.has(R.AI);
    const maxT = isPP ? 40 : 15;
    const WHALE = 100000;

    function header() {
      if (!isPP) return '';
      let bv = 0, sv = 0;
      tradesBuffer.forEach(t2 => { if (t2.isBuy) bv += t2.usd; else sv += t2.usd; });
      const tot = bv + sv, pct = tot > 0 ? (bv / tot) * 100 : 50;
      const label = pct > 55 ? t('trades.buyers') : pct < 45 ? t('trades.sellers') : t('trades.balance');
      const color = pct > 55 ? 'var(--green)' : pct < 45 ? 'var(--red)' : '#aaa';
      return `<div class="tr-summary"><div class="tr-stat"><span class="tr-l">${t('trades.aggression')}</span><span class="tr-v" style="color:${color}">${pct.toFixed(0)}% ${label}</span></div><div class="tr-bar"><div class="tr-bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div><div class="tr-nums"><span style="color:var(--green)">▲ ${(bv/1000).toFixed(1)}K</span><span style="color:var(--red)">▼ ${(sv/1000).toFixed(1)}K</span></div></div>`;
    }

    const lower = sym.toLowerCase();
    try {
      wsTrades = new WebSocket(`wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/${lower}@aggTrade`);
      wsTrades.onmessage = (e) => {
        try {
          const d = JSON.parse(e.data);
          const price = parseFloat(d.p), qty = parseFloat(d.q), usd = price * qty;
          tradesBuffer.unshift({ price, qty, usd, isBuy: !d.m, time: d.T });
          if (tradesBuffer.length > maxT) tradesBuffer.length = maxT;
          const head = header();
          const rows = tradesBuffer.map(t2 => {
            const tstr = new Date(t2.time).toLocaleTimeString(currentLang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'ru-RU', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
            const whale = isPP && t2.usd > WHALE ? ' whale' : '';
            return `<div class="trade-row ${t2.isBuy ? 'buy' : 'sell'}${whale}"><span class="t-time">${tstr}</span><span class="t-price">${fmtPrice(t2.price)}</span><span class="t-qty">${fmtQty(t2.qty)}</span></div>`;
          }).join('');
          box.innerHTML = head + rows;
        } catch (_) {}
      };
    } catch (e) { box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#777;">${t('orderbook.error')}</div>`; }
  }
  function stopTrades(){ if (wsTrades) { try { wsTrades.close(); } catch (_) {} wsTrades = null; } }

  function onAssetChange(sym) {
    if (sym === currentSym) return;
    currentSym = sym;
    safe('loadFutures', () => loadFutures(sym));
    safe('loadGlobal', () => loadGlobal());
    safe('startOrderbook', () => startOrderbook(sym));
    safe('startTrades', () => startTrades(sym));
  }
  function refreshAll(){ if (currentSym) onAssetChange(currentSym); }

  return { onAssetChange, refreshAll, stopAll: () => { stopOrderbook(); stopTrades(); } };
})();
window.__EXTRA = EXTRA;

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const tag = (e.target.tagName || '').toUpperCase();
  if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'SELECT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA') return;
  const key = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (key === '1') document.querySelector('#intervalTabs [data-iv="15m"]')?.click();
  else if (key === '2') document.querySelector('#intervalTabs [data-iv="1h"]')?.click();
  else if (key === '3') document.querySelector('#intervalTabs [data-iv="4h"]')?.click();
  else if (key === '4') document.querySelector('#intervalTabs [data-iv="1d"]')?.click();
  else if (key === '5') document.querySelector('#intervalTabs [data-iv="1w"]')?.click();
  else if (key === 'w') { if (state.snapshot) toggleWatch(state.snapshot.assetKey); }
  else if (key === 'f') { e.preventDefault(); $('searchInput').focus(); }
  else if (key === 'a') { e.preventDefault(); openAlertModal(); }
  else if (key === 'escape') { closeAlertModal(); $('suggestions').classList.remove('open'); }
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
    const d = Storage.load();
    const keys = d.watchlist.length ? d.watchlist : ['BTCUSDT','ETHUSDT','SOLUSDT','BNBUSDT','XRPUSDT','ZECUSDT','AAPL','TSLA','NVDA','SPY','EURUSD','USDJPY','XAUUSD'];
    const cur = keys.indexOf(state.assetKey);
    if (cur === -1) return;
    const next = e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? (cur + 1) % keys.length : (cur - 1 + keys.length) % keys.length;
    selectAsset(keys[next]);
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
